summary: Fire tower erected by Fromm Brothers of Hamburg in Lincoln County by January 1940 from salvaged radio-tower steel; listed as gone; site today unrecorded.

facts.design: Steel framework salvaged from a 150-foot radio tower dismantled near Janesville
facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains on the site

events.note: Newspaper item dated 16 January 1940, quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, says Fromm Brothers had erected the tower

evidence.supports: Fromm Brothers of Hamburg erected a fire tower in the town of Corning, about 12 miles west of Merrill, on land the firm owns
evidence.quote: Utilizing the steel framework of a 150-foot radio tower dismantled near Janesville, Fromm Brothers, of Hamburg, have erected a fire tower in the town of Corning, Lincoln county, about 12 miles west of Merrill, where the firm owns a large tract of land.

evidence.supports: builders used steel framework from a dismantled 150-foot radio tower
evidence.quote: Utilizing the steel framework of a 150-foot radio tower dismantled near Janesville

evidence.supports: state conservation department maintaining fire towers in Corning and other Lincoln County towns
evidence.quote: Fire towers are being maintained by the state conservation department in the towns of Corning, Rock Falls, Harrison and some in Lincoln county.

evidence.supports: Fromm tower brought the county's count of fire towers to five
evidence.quote: The Fromm tower in the town of Corning increases the number of fire towers in that county to five.

evidence.supports: listed as gone on the Wisconsin lookout list
Wisconsin towers of that period were built in the 1930s and 1940s
evidence.quote: Built in the 1930's and 1940's, the towers at the time were the front line to protect Wisconsin's forests.

evidence.supports: in 2015 the DNR announced the towers were being removed
evidence.quote: The DNR announced late last week the fire towers used to spot out of control fires were being eliminated.
Fromm Lookout Tower is a tower located in Lincoln County, WI
at an elevation of 1489 ft MSL

sources.title: Fromm (quoting the Wausaw [sic] Daily Herald, 16 January 1940)
State fire towers to leave the landscape

notes_for_editor: The 1940 build date rests on one newspaper item as quoted by the Forest Lookouts page; not checked against the newspaper or state files. The item's sentence on state maintenance covers fire towers in several Lincoln County towns and does not name this tower's agency, so no agency fact is recorded. Project record fields height_m 45.7 and status_raw 'dismantled' come from the central_us_lookouts extract (150 ft); neither appears in the cached page text, so neither is used. The OSM node carries no status tag; the 'standing' label in data/sources/osm.json is a default. Location and elevation match the record (TopoQuest 1489 ft). Do not confuse with the Fromm Brothers farm in Hamburg, a separate place. Suggested checks: Wisconsin Historical Society Architecture and History Inventory and DNR records for the tower; 1939-40 Wausau-area newspapers for the erection date; any photo of the site.
